tytul: Dry krakowska sausage: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for dry krakowska, a sausage that is smoked, cooked and then dried (Polish kiełbasa krakowska sucha).

ostrzezenia.tekst: UGA recommends cooking products made from ground pork and beef to an internal temperature of 160 °F.
Too much nitrate or nitrite can be toxic to people.
According to UGA, a sausage is shelf stable only when its water activity is below 0.85 and its pH is under 5.3.

akapity: UGA has a recipe for a smoked and cooked Polish sausage, but it is not a recipe for dry krakowska.
JarAtlas has no home method to measure water activity or pH.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for dry krakowska from a checked source.
